restaurant_name: คลินิกกระดูกและข้อหมอเทพ Dr.Thep Orthopedic Clinic Pattaya
text:
I was extremely disappointed with my visit to this clinic.

Before my visit, I was told that a doctor's consultation would cost 800 baht, and an X-ray would cost another 800 baht. Based on this, I expected the cost to be around 1,600 baht. However, I was later billed approximately 3,500 baht without a clear explanation of how this amount was calculated.

I thoroughly described my medical history and situation to the doctor before the consultation, but I got the impression that he didn't even bother to carefully read the information or understand my case. The consultation was superficial, and the answers to my questions were extremely general.

I would also like to specifically mention the medication prescribed. I was told it would help solve my problem. After the consultation, I independently researched the medication and found no evidence that it could correct bowed legs. When I returned to the doctor for clarification, he himself confirmed that this medication does not correct bowed legs and can only be used as maintenance therapy. This raises the question of why I was initially given a different impression. I was also very dissatisfied with the staff's attitude. Instead of a calm explanation of the cost of services and answers to my questions, I encountered irritation, a raised voice, and disrespectful behavior. When I asked to see the X-rays that had been taken at my expense, the staff's reaction was also extremely negative.

After I refused to buy the prescribed medications, the payment amount suddenly changed. Initially, I was told to pay about 2,300 baht. When I explained that I only had 2,100 baht with me, they simply asked me to pay that amount. This raised even more questions about the clinic's transparency.

Furthermore, I felt that the reviews about the clinic don't reflect the actual level of service. Perhaps other patients have had better luck, but my experience was extremely negative.

In the end, I paid the money, received no solution to my problem, received no clear explanation of the cost of services, and was treated disrespectfully by the staff. Personally, I will not return here again and recommend other patients clarify all costs in advance before beginning treatment. I'd like to add:
1. I wasn't prescribed any injections. This is a lie, which the clinic started writing after my review, trying to justify themselves to the public.

2. I didn't raise my voice or cause a conflict. The nurse was the first to act aggressively: raising her voice, getting nervous, and pointing at my phone screen.

3. The doctor didn't fully review my medical history. I had prepared a detailed description of my problem in advance using a translator, but the doctor only read part of it and asked almost no questions.

4. They started prescribing medications and vitamins without any tests. For example, B vitamins. But how can you prescribe vitamins to someone without checking their tests and determining whether they have a deficiency?

5. When I told the doctor that I'd been taking B vitamins for years, he simply replied, "Then don't bother." This seemed extremely unprofessional to me.

6. Initially, I was quoted one price for the services, but later the amount changed. Once the staff realized I wasn't going to agree to everything and pay without question, their attitude changed dramatically.

I got the impression that tourists are treated well here only as long as they're trying to get as much money out of them as possible. As soon as they realize a person is asking questions and isn't prepared to pay for dubious treatments, their behavior changes dramatically.

My review is based solely on my personal experience. I'm not making anything up and I'm not trying to slander anyone.

People, take care of your health and choose your clinics carefully.
